quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Toyama's final-year 2022-2026 latter basic plan, FY2026 implementation plan, FY2026 budget-proposal route, FY2024 settlement route, and active next-plan transition. It does not promote draft next-plan content, project results, fiscal values, achievement judgments, causal attribution, or cross-city comparability.
